# Phoenix Gravity Water Filters by Sani Hellas

> Phoenix Gravity is a gravity-fed water filtration system using activated coconut shell charcoal filters that removes 99% of contaminants while preserving beneficial minerals. NSF-certified (NSF/ANSI 42 &amp; 53). Serving Greece and Cyprus. Greek-speaking consumers seeking home water filtration solutions.

> ## Target Audience
Greek-speaking consumers seeking home water filtration solutions. Health-conscious families, off-grid living, emergency preparedness, outdoor enthusiasts.

## Products
- Phoenix Gravity Water Filter System (complete system)
- Activated Carbon Replacement Filters
- Fluoride Post-Treatment Filters (POStreat)
- Stainless Steel Spigots (standard and with level indicator)
- Stainless Steel Water Bottles
- Teak Wooden Stands
- Silicone Hole Blocker Plugs
- Installation Kits and Spare Parts

- Homepage: https://phoenixwaterfilters.gr/
